issue: Broken link to a page on your own site
how_to_fix: Find the link on the page listed and point it at a page that exists (Online Store > Navigation for menus, or edit the page/product text). If the page moved, add a redirect: Online Store > Navigation > View URL redirects.

issue: Broken image
how_to_fix: Open the product/page in admin and re-upload the image.

issue: Menu and footer disagree
detail: 'terms of service' goes to different places: https://practice-store.example/pages/terms-of-service (main menu); https://practice-store.example/policies/terms-of-service (footer)
how_to_fix: Online Store > Navigation: open the main menu and the footer menu and point both items at the same page. For policies, use the built-in Shopify policy pages (Settings > Policies).

issue: Structured data is broken (bad JSON)
how_to_fix: Usually from an app or a custom code snippet. Online Store > Themes > Edit code, or turn off the app that adds it. Test fixes at https://search.google.com/test/rich-results

issue: Image has no alt text
how_to_fix: Products: click the image in admin > 'Add alt text'. Pages/theme: Online Store > Customize > the image block > 'Image alt text'. Describe it like you'd tell a friend: 'Vintage 1965 Snoopy Hallmark ornament, red doghouse'.

issue: Meta description looks cut off mid-sentence
detail: …who wants a centerpiece for their binder or display case and
how_to_fix: Admin > 'Search engine listing' > Edit > write a complete sentence or two, 120-155 characters.

issue: No meta description
how_to_fix: Product/collection/page in admin > scroll to 'Search engine listing' > Edit > write 1-2 sentences (120-155 characters).

issue: Product structured data is missing details
detail: missing: brand (says 'Rescue Retro Relics', not the real maker)
how_to_fix: Missing brand = the Vendor field says 'Rescue Retro Relics' or is blank (the Vendor fixer tool handles this). Missing price/availability usually means a theme or app problem.

issue: Meta description very short
how_to_fix: Admin > 'Search engine listing' > Edit > expand to 120-155 characters.

issue: Same meta description on several pages
detail: shared with 6 other page(s): 'vintage and retro collectibles, snoopy, sonny angel and re-ment finds.'
how_to_fix: Give each page its own description in 'Search engine listing'.

issue: Heading levels skip (e.g. H2 then H4)
how_to_fix: In the page text editor, change the skipped heading to the next level down (H2 > H3 > H4).

issue: More than one main heading (H1)
how_to_fix: Check the page in Customize. If a logo or banner is an H1, change the extra one to a smaller heading.
